title: Season Pass Reduction on a Resort Lodging Room Rate
content:
A household shown on the collective's records as holding a season pass has a reduction taken on the room rate of a Resort Lodging stay, and how much of that reduction is taken turns on whose name the pass stands in.

Where a season pass standing active for the season of the stay is registered to the guest named as the lead guest on the reservation, the whole of the unit type's passholder reduction is taken.

Where a season pass standing active for the season of the stay stands on the household account but is registered to someone other than the lead guest, the household share of that reduction is taken, that share being one half of it, or 50 percent of the unit type's published passholder reduction.

Where no season pass stands active for the season of the stay on the household account, no passholder reduction is taken.

## What the records must show

The pass records read are the household's season pass records under the collective's Season Pass Programme: their standing, the name of the passholder each is registered to, and the season each is held for. Two things are read together, the pass standing active and the season it is held for being the season of the stay; a pass held for another season, or one no longer standing active, answers neither tier. The lead guest is the guest named as such on the Resort Lodging reservation.

| What the season pass records show | What is taken |
| --- | --- |
| A pass standing active for the season of the stay, registered to the lead guest | the whole of the unit type's passholder reduction |
| A pass standing active for the season of the stay on the household account, registered to someone else | one half of that reduction, being 50 percent of it |
| No pass standing active for the season of the stay | no passholder reduction |

### Three hypothetical households

A household whose season pass stands active for the season of the stay in the name of the parent who is also the lead guest on the reservation has the whole of the unit type's passholder reduction taken.

A household whose season pass stands active for the season of the stay in the name of a grandparent, while the reservation names a parent as lead guest, has one half of that reduction taken, which for a unit type publishing a passholder reduction of 12.5 percent comes to a reduction of 6.25 percent.

A household whose only season pass was held for the previous season has no pass standing active for the season of the stay, and no passholder reduction is taken.
